nextWorkerSelectionDecision: After the authorized experiment, retain the ordinary baseline if its actual output is adequate. Propose a procedure-only comparison only for a consequential observed reusable weakness, with equal model/tools/context/limits and fresh plus regression evidence.
nextBusinessDecision: Separate whether the runtime can deliver useful bounded software from whether a consenting operator gains enough over competent existing tools to justify adoption.
